{"code": "import statsmodels.api as sm

# Prepare data for regression: one-hot encode categorical variables
# Drop the baseline for each categorical variable to avoid multicollinearity
X = pd.get_dummies(data_clean, columns=['site', 'severity', 'sex', 'assay_batch'], drop_first=True)

# Define the outcome and predictors
y = X['biomarker_change']
X = X.drop(columns=['biomarker_change', 'patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'arm'])

# Add constant for intercept
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit linear regression model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# Extract treatment effect (coefficient for treatment arm)
treatment_effect = model.params['arm[T.treatment]']
std_error = model.bse['arm[T.treatment]']
conf_int = model.conf_int().loc['arm[T.treatment]']

# Print results
print("Regression Results:")
print(model.summary())

# Report the effect
print(f"\nTreatment effect (adjusted): {treatment_effect:.3f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_error:.3f}")
print(f"95% CI: [{conf_int[0]:.3f}, {conf_int[1]:.3f}]")"}
